Balloon position was confirmed by an occlusion test using chest compressions in passive patients (inspiratory efforts if breathing spontaneously), which is an occlusion manoeuvre, not signal-quality verification only.
No interval from the reference event is reported; null is the codebook's representation, GLM's all-null object carries no information.

Titration follows 10 min of basic ventilation and all timepoints (0, 24, 48, 72 h) are counted from the onset of mechanical ventilation; enrolment is not the stated anchor. Intubation is the nearest enum.
Results report cohort APACHE II mean 24.5+/-13.8 for all 62 patients.
Obesity was not required, BMI is not reported, and mean weight is 64.1+/-20.3 kg; a mean BMI of 30 would need a mean height below 1.47 m, so non_obese_population is defensible from recorded data.

TPO targeted end-expiratory Ptp between 0 and 10 cmH2O (the EPVent-1 positive range) with end-inspiratory Ptp <25; there is no separate zero-target strategy, so only absolute_positive_end_expiratory_ptp applies.
